title: NEW Airports Drop! Recife International Airport , Naha & MORE — MSFS Marketplace Update (PC)
description:
🔍 Description
The week of January 29, 2026 brings another exciting Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update! This week is packed with must‑have new PC airports and gorgeous regional scenery upgrades that every simmer will want to explore.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 HRSimYard: HEMS Innsbruck (Scenic helicopter ops in the Austrian Alps)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: LCEN Ercan International Airport (Northern Cyprus regional gateway)
🛫 KiwiFlightSim: NSAS Ofu NSFQ Fitiuta Manua Islands (Remote island airstrips in the Pacific)
🛫 KiwiFlightSim: NSFA Faleolo International Airport, Samoa (Primary international hub of Samoa)
🛫 ACO Design Studio: ROAH Naha Airport (Key airport in Okinawa, Japan)
🛫 Paulo Ricardo: SBRF Recife International Airport (Busy Brazilian airport with coastal approaches)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Dreamscenery: Charleston Region Enhanced Road Lights (Improved night lighting)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Cheyenne Region Enhanced Road Lights (Enhanced road illumination)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Concord Region Enhanced Road Lights (Upgraded regional night lighting)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Dubai Region Enhanced Road Lights (Stunning improvements to Dubai’s night glow)
🌆 dominicdesignteam: HO CHI MINH CITY LANDMARKS (Iconic landmarks added in Vietnam)
🌆 SamScene3D: Kuala Lumpur Mega City (Dense custom cityscape for Malaysia’s capital)

If you enjoyed this week’s breakdown, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for more flight‑sim content, and let me know in the comments which new airport or scenery you'll be flying into first!

✈️ See you in the skies!
